listing.name: LEGO Island / isle-portable (isledecomp)
listing.summary: Explore LEGO Island / isle-portable (isledecomp) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Prepare your original game
steps.instruction: Use the linked upstream guided installer/setup instructions for your own English LEGO Island 1.1 data. For this portable archive, run the included bin/isle-config.exe yourself, choose the original data and save locations, and save the configuration. Portcove’s Play target is bin/isle.exe; read-only discovery and installation do not run the configuration helper. On Linux x86-64, run the included bin/isle-config yourself (it needs Qt 6 from your distribution); Portcove’s Play target is bin/isle. Keep bin/ and lib/ together. The Linux player and its bundled libraries need glibc 2.43 or later, GCC 13’s libstdc++ and OpenGL ES 2 with GLVND. The continuous channel follows upstream’s ongoing builds and may regress.

presentation.manual_preparation: Use the linked upstream guided installer/setup instructions for your own English LEGO Island 1.1 data. For this portable archive, run the included bin/isle-config.exe yourself, choose the original data and save locations, and save the configuration. Portcove’s Play target is bin/isle.exe; read-only discovery and installation do not run the configuration helper. On Linux x86-64, run the included bin/isle-config yourself (it needs Qt 6 from your distribution); Portcove’s Play target is bin/isle. Keep bin/ and lib/ together. The Linux player and its bundled libraries need glibc 2.43 or later, GCC 13’s libstdc++ and OpenGL ES 2 with GLVND. The continuous channel follows upstream’s ongoing builds and may regress. Normal configuration and saves live in the SDL preference folder AppData/isledecomp/isle on Windows or ~/.local/share/isledecomp/isle on Linux, or in the save location you choose, outside Portcove backups. The executable-folder isle.ini fallback is declared; original media and custom save folders remain external. Custom profiles, runtime extensions and existing copies retain the non-owning route. Existing external installations keep their files and runtime owner. Source/package inspection is separate from original-input, gameplay, minimum-environment and packaged Desktop acceptance observations.
